name: file_write

ownership.argument: Write through a retained struct file without resolving any caller fd. Returns negative errno directly. The caller pins the file object for the write.

provenance.source: Exact Q66 .155 IDB recovery for fd-independent QJS event-loop notification, 2026-10-30; native async wake EBADF captured at C3F5758.

notes: Private exact-target ABI record; not public callable approval or physical validation. Entry bytes: 80 b5 84 b0 00 af 07 f1 08 03 3b 60. NuttX file slots are 32 bytes (C332B70). File references increment under interrupt critical section (C332B78-C332B7E).
